name: firmware-zmk
description: Builds ZMK firmware with the CI's own flags in ZMK's pinned image, then checks deep-sleep wakeup sources and radio transmit power.
lenses: the image that is not the one pinned
origin: written for a handheld keyboard deck on an nRF52840 module whose CI had never built its firmware, whose deep sleep had no wakeup source and whose radio ran past its module's grant. Its controls are upstream ZMK's corne; no project's design came with it.
